name: web_search
description:
Search the web using 6 parallel engines (Bing/Baidu/360/Sogou/Shenma/Toutiao) with DDG fallback. Returns webpage results with title, URL and snippet. Use for general information queries.

FIELD NAME: The only required parameter is 'query' (NOT 'topic', NOT 'keywords').

query.description: Search query string (required). Do NOT use 'topic' or 'keywords' as field name.

region.description: Region code (wt-wt: worldwide, cn-zh: China, us-en: US)
